text: Choose a pretend goodbye story. Your real grown-up stays with you while we play.
It is pretend pick-up time. Tap the door to say hello again.
Now wash and dry hands with a grown-up. Tap the sink to pretend together.
We can take a break. Choose another story whenever you are ready.
We did it together! You can play again or choose all done.
Goodnight time
It is bedtime. Move our buddy to the cozy bed.
Our buddy is ready to rest. Which words fit bedtime?
These are bedtime words. Try a goodnight message.
Our buddy is tucked in. You practiced a gentle goodnight.
Good night!
Sweet dreams!
Have fun at school!
Good night! Tap the lamp to dim the light.
Sweet dreams! Tap the lamp to dim the light.
School drop-off
Move our buddy to the school door. A trusted teacher is waiting.
It is time for school. What can we say to our grown-up?
We are saying goodbye for a school day. Try words for drop-off.
Hello again! In our story, pick-up time came and the grown-up returned.
Bye! See you at pick-up time!
Have a good day!
Bye! See you at pick-up time! Tap the toys for pretend playtime with the teacher.
Have a good day! Tap the toys for pretend playtime with the teacher.
Daycare goodbye
Move our buddy to the playroom door. A trusted caregiver will stay.
Our buddy is ready for daycare. Which goodbye fits?
We are starting daycare. Choose words for a daytime goodbye.
Hello again! Our buddy and grown-up are together at pretend pick-up time.
Bye! See you later!
See you at pick-up time!
Time to flush!
Bye! See you later! Tap the toys for pretend playtime with the caregiver.
See you at pick-up time! Tap the toys for pretend playtime with the caregiver.
Time to go home
Dinner is ready. Move our buddy toward home, with a grown-up.
It is time to leave our friends for dinner. What can we say?
We are leaving our friends for dinner. Try a friendly goodbye.
Our buddy went in for dinner. We can thank friends when playtime ends.
Bye, friends! Dinner time!
Thanks for playing!
Good morning!
Bye, friends! Dinner time! Tap the doorway to go inside with a grown-up.
Thanks for playing! Tap the doorway to go inside with a grown-up.
Leaving the park
Park playtime is ending. Move our buddy to the gate with a grown-up.
What could we say as we leave the park?
Park playtime is ending. Try goodbye words for our friends.
You practiced leaving the park with a friendly wave and a grown-up.
Bye! That was fun!
See you another day!
Bye! That was fun! Tap the waving hand to wave goodbye together.
See you another day! Tap the waving hand to wave goodbye together.
A visit ends
Our visit is ending. Move our buddy to the front door with a grown-up.
What could we say after a visit with someone we care about?
Our visit is ending. Choose a kind goodbye.
You thanked someone and said goodbye. Hugs are always a choice.
Thank you for having us!
Bye! See you another time!
Thank you for having us! Tap the hand for a goodbye wave. A wave is enough.
Bye! See you another time! Tap the hand for a goodbye wave. A wave is enough.
Bye-bye, poo
Our buddy is done on the potty. Move them to the handwashing spot.
We are finished with the potty. Which goodbye fits?
This is a potty goodbye. Try words for being all done.
All done! We practiced flushing and washing hands with grown-up help.
Bye-bye, poo!
All done! Time to flush!
Bye-bye, poo! Tap the flush button and watch the water swirl.
All done! Time to flush! Tap the flush button and watch the water swirl.
Bye-bye, pee
Bye-bye, pee!
Bye-bye, pee! Tap the flush button and watch the water swirl.
